t: Professional labelling tool with solid design and rubber impact guards to handle bumps and drops. Access all the electrical, datacomms, telecom contractor and AV security systems installer application keys needed on a routine basis. 5 different label widths from 3.5mm up to 18mm, printing up to 2 lines per print. Backlit LCD display. Supplied with carry case, rechargeable Li-ion battery, AC adaptor and black on yellow strong adhesive tape.
